title: Try this app!
body: As someone that has at least half a dozen calendar apps and to do list apps….this is brilliant. Was 4 days into my week free trial and bought the lifetime subscription. 100% worth it. I had trouble with my subscription and emailed support - had a reply in under 24 hours despite it being holiday time. If you aren’t sure - sign up for the week free trial.
author: Yume2342
